caption: A match is struck against the side of its box, and it flares into a flame that settles to a steady burn.

sa.check: A match is struck against the side of its box.
A flame appears at the match head.
The flame settles to a steady burn.
The matchstick blackens behind the flame.
The order is strike, flare, steady burn.

pc.expect: The flame appears at the head at the moment it scrapes the box and not before.
pc.fail: The flame appears before the head touches the box; or the head scrapes across the box and no flame appears at all; or the flame appears at the stick's far end; or the flame appears with the match held clear of the box.

pc.expect: The flame flares and then settles to a steady burn, and the blackening behind it only spreads.
pc.fail: The flame settles and then flares up again with nothing added; or a blackened part of the stick turns back to pale wood; or the flame goes out and relights by itself; or the blackening retreats along the stick.

pc.expect: The flame points upward whatever way the match is held.
pc.fail: The flame points downward; or leans with the match rather than standing upright; or hangs below the head; or points along the stick toward the fingers whatever way is up.

pc.expect: The matchstick stays a stiff stick that blackens and curls where it has burnt, and the box stays a rigid box.
pc.fail: The stick melts and drips; or stays pale and straight where the flame has passed; or the box catches and vanishes at once; or the stick stretches as it burns.

pc.expect: One match and one box; the match shortens only by burning and the box keeps its shape.
pc.fail: A second flame appears on the stick; or the match vanishes while still long; or the flame detaches from the match and floats; or the box changes into another object.

pc.expect: The box's label, the hand and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The box's label changes; or the background changes between frames; or the unburnt part of the stick changes colour.

note: The hand is kept because striking is the caption's action; it is otherwise not judged.
